newsitem.title: UK: Roxboro to sell assets to Siemens.
newsitem.headline: Roxboro to sell assets to Siemens.

text.p: British instrumentation and specialist components company Roxboro Group plc said on Friday it had agreed to sell select assets of its BLP Components unit to Germany's Siemens AG.
The transaction will include assets, know-how, order book and stock relating to its telecom relay activities.
Roxboro said the transaction would have little effect on its profits in the current financial year but would benefit the group in future years.
"...Having eliminated these low margin products, enabling the group to focus further on its higher value added product areas," the company said.
The sale is part of its plans to reduce its exposure to commodity components markets, it said.
Its share price closed 211-1/2 pence on Thursday.
